analyticalQuestion: What are the latest interim observations, separated by standalone quarter and YTD class?
comparabilityRequirements: No layer-wide or market-wide financial totals.
Annual and interim observations are not mixed.
Missing and withheld values remain unavailable, not zero.
Company-wide financial observations are not AI-specific allocations.
limitationText: Standalone-quarter, YTD, and other interim periods must be displayed separately and not compared as identical durations.
metricDefinition: Latest interim observations per company and metric without treating different interim durations as equivalent.
